entries.description: Find your tldraw.com boards by name, then read their pages, shape clusters and rendered screenshots. Requires a signed-in tldraw.com account over OAuth 2.1.
representativeQueries: find my tldraw board about onboarding
show me what is on this tldraw board
screenshot the flowchart on page 2 of this tldraw board
what shapes are in the top-left cluster of this board
